status: draft-before-outcome-access; independent review required before campaign freeze
classification: retrospective rule-level falsification on reused calendars; not a fresh sample, not prospective, not a return strategy, and not a deployment claim

hypothesis.causal_story: Perpetual taker aggression that is not matched by spot taker aggression indicates leveraged directional crowding rather than cash demand. Leveraged longs carry a maintenance-margin overhang: adverse moves force price-insensitive selling, while favourable moves force nothing. The asymmetry of the constraint, not its level, is the testable implication.
hypothesis.primary_claim: When trailing-24h perpetual taker-buy share exceeds spot taker-buy share, the next 24 hours should show relatively more downside than upside realized semivariance.
hypothesis.checkable_edge: Pooled Spearman rho between x and y >= 0.08, positive per asset, upper-minus-lower signal-quintile median y gap >= log(1.10), and one-sided 7-date block-bootstrap p < 0.05.

distinct_from_closed_families.focused-liquidation-overlay: That mechanism conditioned on realized forceOrder onsets and tested intraday continuation in the liquidation direction. This one never observes a liquidation, tests no direction, and predicts the asymmetry of dispersion over a fixed next-day window.
distinct_from_closed_families.focused-deribit-gex: That used Deribit option dealer gamma from taker option trades against realized volatility. This uses Binance spot and perpetual futures taker quote volume and an asymmetry ratio.
distinct_from_closed_families.funding-crowding, crypto-carry-decay, fo: All conditioned on funding rates, the price of leverage. This conditions on signed taker flow shares and never reads a funding archive.
distinct_from_closed_families.crypto-basis-convergence, btc-eth-relati: Price-spread mechanisms. No spread appears here.
distinct_from_closed_families.crypto-trend-vol, focused-crypto-cross-s: Price-momentum, cross-sectional, macro-state, option-premium, or positioning-report mechanisms; none uses exchange taker-share composition.
distinct_from_closed_families.perp-spot-activity-volatility: Closed FROZEN-NEGATIVE on 2026-09-01. It used UNSIGNED total quote volume as a ratio of venues, and its outcome was the LEVEL of volatility relative to a trailing baseline shared with the signal window. This mechanism uses the SIGNED taker share difference and an outcome computed entirely inside the future window, so no term is shared between signal and outcome.

hypothesis.source_context: He, Manela, Ross and von Wachter, arXiv:2212.06888, characterise perpetuals as the leverage channel; the liquidation-cascade literature (arXiv:2607.27070, arXiv:2512.01112) documents forced price-insensitive selling as the amplification mechanism. Neither supplies or validates this rule.

novelty_and_consumption.calendar_reuse: Both windows fall inside 2026-01..2026-07, which historical-confirmation/results.json shows was consumed by crypto-carry-decay (through 2026-07-31) and factor-momentum-timing (through 2026-06-30). No freshness is claimed.
novelty_and_consumption.outcome_observation_disjointness: This session has observed no outcome statistic on 2026-01-01..2026-07-01. The closed perp-spot-activity-volatility campaign spent only 2025-07-01..2026-01-01 and its frozen 2026-01..2026-07 replication window was never executed, so no gate, correlation, or verdict from that contract ever read these dates.
novelty_and_consumption.rule_level_claim: No registered artifact reads taker_buy_quote_volume or tests taker-share divergence against semivariance asymmetry. Verified by search: no exploration file matches taker_buy_(quote_)?volume, takerBuy, or positional row[8]/row[9]/row[10] access.
novelty_and_consumption.column_novelty: taker_buy_quote_volume (kline column 9) and quote_volume (column 7) are used jointly for the first time in this workspace as a signed composition signal.

assets_and_data.integrity: All 32 immutable zip SHA-256 values matched their upstream .CHECKSUM sidecars before this draft. The runner must re-verify the inventory hash, every archive hash, and every sidecar value before parsing outcomes, and must reject any archive containing more than one member.
assets_and_data.timestamp_rule: Normalize seconds/milliseconds/microseconds to UTC milliseconds by magnitude. Reject duplicate or non-hour-aligned open times, nonpositive closes, negative volumes, and taker_buy_quote_volume outside [0, quote_volume] after a 1e-9 relative tolerance.
assets_and_data.lawfulness: Keyless Binance public archives, internal research only; redistribution per quant-trading/data/manifest.json source_policies.binance.

frozen_rule.decision_clock: 00:00:00 UTC each calendar day; membership uses exchange open_time only.
frozen_rule.signal: Over the 24 complete hourly bars opening t-25h through t-2h, that is the half-open span [t-25h, t-1h): venue_share = sum(taker_buy_quote_volume) / sum(quote_volume), computed separately for USD-M perpetual and spot. x_t = perp_share - spot_share. The bar opening t-1h is deliberately excluded from the signal; it serves only as the outcome anchor. No standardization, winsorization, percentile trigger, or threshold.
frozen_rule.outcome: Anchor on the close of bar t-1h, then take the closes of the 24 bars [t,t+24h) to form exactly 24 forward close-to-close log returns. downside = sum(r^2 for r < 0); upside = sum(r^2 for r > 0). y_t = log(downside / upside).
frozen_rule.outcome_independence: The set of bars entering x and the set entering y are disjoint: x reads bars t-25h..t-2h, y reads bars t-1h..t+23h. There is no shared bar, no shared return, and no shared denominator. The bar opening t-1h is an embargo hour: any transient price impact left by taker activity inside the signal window has one full hour to revert BEFORE the anchor close is taken, and that reverting hour is excluded from y. Residual risk is disclosed rather than denied: impact persisting beyond the embargo hour could still influence the first forward return, so the estimator is not proven unbiased, only structurally decontaminated of the shared-bar channel identified in pre-freeze review.
frozen_rule.completeness: A decision is admitted only if all 24 spot signal bars t-25h..t-2h, the spot anchor bar t-1h, all 24 spot bars [t,t+24h), and all 24 perpetual signal bars t-25h..t-2h are present, and the forward window contains at least 2 strictly negative and at least 2 strictly positive returns. Otherwise the day is rejected and counted by reason.
frozen_rule.sampling: One observation per asset per UTC day; forward windows do not overlap within an asset; BTC and ETH stay paired by date for resampling.
frozen_rule.statistics: Average-rank Spearman correlation. Quintile tails take floor(0.20*n) observations from each end of the pooled ordering of x, with ties broken deterministically by (date, asset); gap = median(y | upper) - median(y | lower).
frozen_rule.bootstrap: 10,000 circular moving-block resamples of UTC dates, seed 20260901, block length 7 dates, whole blocks drawn then truncated to exactly the observed number of dates; assets resampled together. One-sided p = (1 + count(rho_boot <= 0)) / 10001.

windows.context_only: 2025-12 supplies trailing bars for the first decisions and 2026-07 supplies forward bars for the last; context bars never become decisions.

declared_power_limitation: The 180 pooled observations are 90 UTC dates times two assets whose contemporaneous volatility is strongly correlated, so the effective sample is closer to 90 independent dates than to 180 observations. Taking dates as the unit, the standard error of a Spearman correlation is roughly 1/sqrt(89) = 0.106, so the 0.08 effect gate sits BELOW one standard error, and the bootstrap gate, which resamples whole date blocks and therefore respects this dependence, will usually bind first. This contract is well powered to reject a large effect and poorly powered to detect a small one. A failure means the mechanism did not clear a conjunctive bar at this effective sample size; it is not evidence that the effect is exactly zero. This limitation is declared before outcome access, may not be raised afterwards to relitigate a negative verdict, and may not be used to justify enlarging the window after a failure.

gates.G3_economic_magnitude: pooled upper-minus-lower x-quintile median y gap >= log(1.10) = 0.09531017980432493
gates.pass_rule: A window passes only if its minimum sample is met and G1 through G4 are all true. Gates are conjunctive.
gates.fail_rule: If the minimum sample is met and any gate is false, the mechanism fails on that window.
gates.inconclusive_rule: Only missing required bars or an unmet sample minimum yields an inconclusive artifact. Integrity failures (contract, inventory, audit, checksum, or archive-shape mismatch) abort fail-closed and write NO artifact, so corrupted input can never be recorded as any verdict. UNKNOWN never passes.

stopping_and_replication.primary_run: Exactly one outcome-producing execution on the primary window after freeze.
stopping_and_replication.on_primary_fail: Write the negative evidence, close FROZEN-NEGATIVE, and never run replication, tune, extend, pool, or re-window this mechanism.
stopping_and_replication.on_primary_inconclusive: Write evidence and close FROZEN-INCONCLUSIVE without reinterpreting missingness.
stopping_and_replication.on_primary_pass: Run the frozen replication window exactly once with identical code, statistic, gates, and seed.
stopping_and_replication.survival_rule: The mechanism survives only if primary and replication both pass every gate.
stopping_and_replication.write_once: The runner refuses if a requested output path exists. Primary and replication are separate invocations: --window replication requires --primary-artifact whose role is primary, whose contract hash matches, and whose status is pass-on-this-sample.

multiplicity_boundary.interpretation: Per-asset signs, the quintile gap, and the bootstrap are frozen conjunctive diagnostics, not selectable trials. No alternative share definition, lookback, horizon, semivariance threshold, quintile fraction, asset pool, or return conversion may be evaluated under this contract.

claim_boundary: A two-window pass would support only a retrospective conditional-asymmetry regularity on Binance BTC/ETH during 2026 H1. It would not establish tradable alpha, net return after costs, causality, portability across venues or regimes, or any capital-allocation claim. Trading implementation requires a separate preregistered contract and untouched prospective evidence.
